hypothesis: Cosine annealing with warm restarts improves convergence on small transformer models (depth 4, TinyStories)

approach.description: Applied cosine annealing learning rate scheduler with warm restarts to a 4-layer transformer trained on TinyStories dataset. Compared against standard linear decay baseline.

notes: Warm restarts caused instability in models under 10M params. Loss oscillated without converging. Standard linear decay performed 12% better on val_bpb.
